newsitem.title: INDIA: US diplomat in India survived Ethiopian air crash.
newsitem.headline: US diplomat in India survived Ethiopian air crash.

text.p: The U.S. consul general in Bombay and his wife were among the survivors of a hijacked Ethiopian Airlines plane, which plunged into the sea off the Comoro Islands, United States officials said on Sunday.
"Yes, Mr (F.) Huddle and his wife survived with minor injuries. They are OK," Jerry Brenning, director of the U.S. Information Centre in Bombay told Reuters. He did not give details.

Earlier an Indian airport official said 42 of the passengers on board transited from Bombay before boarding the aircraft in Addis Ababa. They included 19 Indians, nine Sri Lankans, nine Nigerians, three Americans, one from the Ivory Coast and another unidentified person.
Brenning said he did not know the identity of the third American.
At least 59 passengers died when the plane crashed off the Comoro Islands after running out of fuel on Saturday and at least 50 survived.
